bio: I'm a senior software developer and junior DevOps engineer: I build the product end to end, then containerise it, provision the cloud under it, and keep it running. At Rever, I work across the stack, from Next.js on the frontend to Django and FastAPI on the backend, then ship it to Kubernetes on AWS. This portfolio is proof of the same approach: an AI twin grounded in real, version-controlled data instead of freeform guesses.
